Kforce has a client that is seeking a Data Analyst - ERP & Master Data in Fort Myers, FL.

Summary:
We are seeking a hands-on Data Integration Analyst to support a complex enterprise data environment with multiple ERP, MES, CRM, HR, finance, and operational source systems. This role is focused on the backend of data, including SQL, ETL, data extraction, cleansing, transformation, mapping, normalization, and integration into a centralized data warehouse.

This is not a traditional BI/reporting position. While reporting experience can be valuable, the primary need is someone who can work directly with databases and raw source data, understand how information is structured across different systems, identify data quality issues, and determine how that data should be standardized and integrated.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  Write complex SQL queries to extract, analyze, validate, and transform data 
  Perform hands-on ETL and data integration across multiple enterprise systems 
  Analyze database structures and identify non-normalized, inconsistent, or incomplete data 
  Clean, parse, transform, and standardize data before integration into the data warehouse 
  Perform data mapping between ERP, MES, CRM, finance, HR, and other business applications 
  Define and recommend normalized data structures, naming conventions, field mappings, and relationships 
  Investigate data quality issues and identify root causes within source systems 
  Work with inconsistent or poorly structured data, including text fields containing numerical or other structured information 
  Support data migrations and integrations as additional systems are consolidated into the enterprise data environment 
  Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to understand how source data should ultimately be represented within the data warehouse 
 
 
  Strong hands-on SQL and relational database experience 
  Experience with ETL, data integration, and data transformation 
  Strong understanding of data normalization and relational data structures 
  Experience with data cleansing, mapping, validation, standardization, and data quality 
  Ability to understand unfamiliar databases and relationships between datasets 
  Experience working with multiple source systems feeding a centralized data warehouse 
  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly with messy or inconsistent source data 

 
Preferred Qualifications:
 
  Experience working with ERP and/or MES data, ideally within a manufacturing environment 
  Experience with platforms such as Infor SyteLine/CSI, ProShop, Epicor, Salesforce, Paylocity, QuickBooks, or Vena 
  Experience supporting ERP migrations, data warehouse initiatives, or enterprise data consolidation
